title: Menu Shaam Sawaire Yaadan Aundian Ne Aaja Akbar
body:
​Menu Shaam Saveeray Yaadan Aaondian Ney Aaja Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Modtaan Tu Main Behtiyan Aa Jaldi Dair Na La Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Chor Gaiyo Gher Kalya
Meray Sir Tay Meri Maa Nai x2
Ek Pal Na Menu Chain Aaway
Gaya Dil Mera Ghabra Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Phat Na Jaway Sughra Da
Jadoo Veendi Aye Band Derwazay x2
Rawan Tu Menu Veer Utha
Hon Ujray Varhay Aa Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoi Zindagi Poori Sughra Di
Akbar Diya Rawaan Taktay x2
Hasrat Na Poori Hovi
Roi Qaber Tayen Sughra Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Chor Kay Roonda Aya
Na Mur Kay Saaraa(n) Laiyaan  x2
Gher Khali Main Na Roi
Na Janday Chor Kay Ja Akbar
